_comment: Tuned for a ~70k hard context limit where quality degrades past ~50k.
pi defaults (reserve 16384 / keepRecent 20000) assume a 200k window and
would let context run to ~184k before compacting -- far past the cliff.
With contextWindow=65536 and reserveTokens=17000, compaction fires at
~48.5k, just under the degradation point rather than at the hard limit.
keepRecentTokens=12000 keeps roughly the last two turns verbatim; the
The real savings come from subagents, not from these numbers: a scout
burns 40k in a CHILD process and returns ~500 tokens to the parent.
